text_to_speech: Firefox has great tools that make it easy to make it your own. To customize Firefox just the way you want, click the menu button and select Customize. Here you can take a feature you use all the time, maybe the find in page tool, and move it to your toolbar. Actually you can put it almost anywhere on the other side of the toolbar, the tab strip or even in the bookmarks toolbar. If there is something you use only once in a while, like the email a link feature, the menu is probably a good place for it. And you can also remove something you don't use at all to keep everything tidy. When you're done, click Exit Customize. Now you've got the perfect Firefox.
